referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset includes all non-hazardous wastes from the combined offshore oil and gas production on the Norwegian Continental Shelf. These are blasting sand, EE-waste, glass, food waste, plastics, wood and other. Metal, cardboard and paper waste are assumed to go to recycling and are therefore not included in this dataset.
